test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Rajeshwar has __a vision__ for capturing beautiful pictures of nature.
solution:
The correct answer is **"An eagle eye"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the sentence is Rajeshwar has **a vision** of taking stunning photos of the natural world.
 
• A vision means something which is seen in the mind. That means a **mental idea** or image of something.
 
• A person with **eagle eyes** notices everything, even the smallest things. That means the ability to see keenly.
 
• Here **"vision"** is used to capture the pictures with a great eye. So an **eagle eye** is the most appropriate noun.

The correct sentence is **Rajeshwar has an eagle eye__ for capturing beautiful pictures of nature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• If you are speaking or acting in a way that suggests you believe you are superior to others or that you know more than they do about anything, you are on your **high horse**. The phrase **"high horse"** has its origins in the Middle Ages, when it was used to describe a** tall riding horse**.
 
• **Cry wolf** is the act of persistently seeking **assistance** when you do not require it, leading others to believe you do not require assistance when you do.
 
• To take a quick sleep is to **"cat nap."**
 
• Therefore, the above three options without "An eagle eye" are not related **idioms** to the underlined word.
